review.rationale: The Decision safely authorizes exactly one local-only fail-closed validation of the frozen 16-file supplement and 28-file base. It binds the exact manifest SHA-256 hashes and commit, enforces a single run with no retry, and mandates validation of 6 Schemas, 6 instances, 5 ephemeral role samples, and all 32 negative cases. The tool inventory explicitly forbids network/DNS/credential access and requires local registry resolution with unknown URI rejection. Result persistence is strictly scoped to exactly two files outside the package, with failure preservation enforced. CE-G13 execution, package mutation, and all commercial/operational/authority elevations are explicitly non-authorized. The recommendation chain is valid, with a qualifying review from qwen3.7-max confirming the soundness of Option A. All authority boundaries are preserved, and the Decision correctly positions itself as authorizing only the bounded offline validation pending remote verification.
